# CloudRent Pro

> CloudRent Pro is Australian-built rental management software for equipment hire businesses. It replaces multiple disconnected tools (booking spreadsheets, paper safety records, separate invoicing apps) with one platform covering bookings, dispatch, AI damage detection, digital signatures, customer self-service and accounting integration.

CloudRent Pty Ltd has been building software for the hire and rental industry since 2017. The company is based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.

## Product suite

- [CloudRent Pro](https://www.cloudrent.me/): Web app for business owners and staff. The core platform.
- [CloudRent Command](https://www.cloudrent.me/mobile-app/): Mobile app for managers and admins.
- [CloudRent Crew](https://www.cloudrent.me/mobile-app/): Mobile app for drivers and warehouse technicians.
- [CloudRent Connect](https://www.cloudrent.me/web-portal/): 24/7 customer self-service portal for bookings and payments.

## Key pages

- [Features overview](https://www.cloudrent.me/features/): Full feature list including equipment management, dispatch, safety compliance, invoicing.
- [Pricing](https://www.cloudrent.me/pricing/): Launch partner pricing at $85/user/month AUD, locked for life. Standard pricing $129/user/month.
- [AI damage detection](https://www.cloudrent.me/ai-damage-detection/): AI-powered photo analysis for equipment damage assessment.
- [Web portal](https://www.cloudrent.me/web-portal/): Office command centre for bookings, invoicing and reports.
- [Mobile app](https://www.cloudrent.me/mobile-app/): iOS and Android apps with offline support.
- [About](https://www.cloudrent.me/about/): Company background and team.
- [Blog](https://www.cloudrent.me/posts/): Industry articles on rental operations, WHS compliance and software selection.

## Common questions

- **Who is CloudRent for?** Equipment hire businesses of any size, from single-operator to multi-location. Industries served include construction equipment, scaffolding, event hire, fence hire, transportable buildings, film equipment.
- **Where is CloudRent based?** Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. 100% Australian built and owned.
- **What does it integrate with?** Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB, Stripe, Twilio (SMS and click-to-call), Google Calendar.
- **Does it work offline?** Yes, the mobile apps support offline use. The web portal requires internet.
- **Is there a free trial?** Yes. A $1 trial with full access. No setup fees. 30-day money-back guarantee.
